newsitem.title: USA: Soros drops nominees to WMX board.
newsitem.headline: Soros drops nominees to WMX board.

text.p: Soros Fund Managment Llc said Thursday it will not proceed with attempts to elect a slate of nominees to WMX Technologies Inc's board of directors, citing recent discussions with senior company representatives.

As a result of the discussions "we have become convinced that the company will undertake sincere and successful efforts to bring two new, independent members onto the Board of Directors, and will pursue the hiring of the best new Chief Executive Officer available," Stanley Druckenmiller, chief Investment Officer of Soros Fund Management said in a statement.
Earlier this week, under pressure from financier George Soros' fund and others over the company's sagging stock price, WMX chief executive officer Phillip Rooney resigned from the company.
In the statement, Druckenmiller said a proxy contest over the nominees would be a distraction to the goal of strenghtenign management and hiring a new chief exectuive officer.
